summary: Updates staging delivery guidance for signed retained runtimes, the current retirement plan contract, and post-route residual pruning recovery.
userImpact: Staging retirement guidance no longer relies on a remembered retained release version or Node's strip-only TypeScript parser.
A failure after sole-route publication can resume through an exact incident-bound residual cleanup without replaying completed lifecycle effects.

instructions: Reinstall version 0.1.11 of the EnterpriseGlue development-workflows plugin after merging this change.

security: The guidance limits post-route recovery to the exact failed run, retained lock generation, signed runtime and original UID/resourceVersion-bound residuals.
documentation: Updates the staging-delivery skill and maintained workflow-plugin guide.
knownLimitations: Executable recovery identities remain fixed in the independently maintained EnterpriseGlue Cloud repository.
rollback: Revert the plugin guidance and version bump; this does not alter deployed Cloud resources.
validation: Run the bundled plugin tests, official Codex skill and plugin validators, documentation-boundary guard, and release-note validation.
